File_Description: Combined CoreMS calibration outputs (.cal files) across all sediment samples. This data is processed from .xml files.

Processed FTICR-MS mass-by-sample data from sediment samples. The first column contains calibrated masses. The following columns are samples. Each row is a peak intensity with values higher than zero indicating the peak is present in that sample. Use the "Calibrated_Mass" column to merge data with the mol files. This data is processed from .xml files.

Processed FTICR-MS data containing molecular information describing each mass value for sediment in the file ending in "CoreMS_Processed_ICR_Data.csv". Use the "Calibrated_Mass" column to merge molecular properties with the data files. This data is processed from .xml files.

R markdown that combines CoreMS outputs (.corems.csv files) contained in a specified directory. Additionally, this markdown will run ftmsRanalysis to calculate additional molecular information and Song et al lambda calculation. See "Instructions_for_Processing_FTICR_Data_using_CoreMS.pdf" for more details.
Python script used to run the CoreMS workflow and generates CoreMS outputs.  See "Instructions_for_Processing_FTICR_Data_using_CoreMS.pdf" for more details.
R script that  formats files from CoreMS outputs into ESS-DIVE CSV reporting format compliant files. This script is provided for traceability.
Instructions for processing FTICR-MS data using the RC-SFA CoreMS pipeline.
R script for the lambda calculation from Song et al 2020 (https://doi.org/10.3389/fmicb.2020.531756). Modified from https://github.com/hyunseobsong/lambda.

CoreMS mass calibration file for sediment samples. This data is processed from the .xml files. The  asterisk * indicates the site ID, followed by  the ion accumulation time (IAT). The "p" in the IAT indicates the decimal point (i.e. p01 indicates an IAT of 0.1 and 1p2 indicates an IAT of 1.2). See the FTICR_Instructions folder and readme for more details.

CoreMS output FTICR-MS files for sediment samples. This data is processed from the .xml files. The  asterisk * indicates the site ID, followed by  the ion accumulation time (IAT). The "p" in the IAT indicates the decimal point (i.e. p01 indicates an IAT of 0.1 and 1p2 indicates an IAT of 1.2). See the FTICR_Instructions folder and readme for more details.

CoreMS setting used at time of analysis for sediment samples. This data is processed from the .xml files. The  asterisk * indicates the site ID, followed by  the ion accumulation time (IAT). Pre-processed FTICR-MS instrument files for sediment samples. The asterisk * indicates the site ID and the ion accumulation time (IAT). The "p" in the IAT indicates the decimal point (i.e. p01 indicates an IAT of 0.1 and 1p2 indicates an IAT of 1.2). See the FTICR_Instructions folder and readme for details on how to process these data.

Pre-processed FTICR-MS instrument files for standard samples (Suwannee River Fulvic Acid II; SRFAII). The asterisk * indicates the replicate number. See the FTICR_Instructions folder and readme for details on how to process these data.
